text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
What I want for my birthday, huh... Oh, I 
know! I want individuality, individuality!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
The bar for this present request is way 
higher than expected... Ugh, 
"individuality", huh...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
In that case, I shall bestow upon you the 
"cha" from Nature. You must now end your 
sentences with "-cha."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: What kind of dialect is that-cha~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Then I'll give you the "Nei" from Nature. 
From now on, your laugh is "Nei-nei."

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Neii-neii-neii-neii-neii!" ...Is that a 
new species of cicada?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Pfft, your usual laugh really is the best. 
It puts me at ease, you know. The usual 
Tannhauser is the nicest.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Oho! You're telling me you're giving me 
the 'Nice' part of Nice Nature?!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No way, no chance. And hey, I'm not giving 
you Nature's share either.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Neei-neii-neii-neii! I'm not giving her 
back today-cha~! You'll have to wait until 
tomorrow for a Nice Machitan-cha~!
